websiteSpec.name: Premium Photography Portfolio
websiteSpec.purpose: To elegantly showcase a photographer's high-quality work and attract prospective clients.
websiteSpec.targetAudience: Art directors, marketing agencies, individuals seeking high-end photography services, and fine art collectors.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: To provide a compelling first impression with hero visuals and a glimpse into the photographer's best work.

pages.title: Portfolio
pages.purpose: To display the photographer's extensive body of work, categorized for easy browsing and detailed viewing.

pages.title: About
pages.purpose: To introduce the photographer, their artistic vision, experience, and professional philosophy.

pages.title: Services
pages.purpose: To outline the various photography services offered, detailing packages and pricing structures.

pages.title: Contact
pages.purpose: To provide clear channels for potential clients to reach out for inquiries, bookings, or collaborations.

features: Large hero section with full-bleed images
Dynamic image gallery with filtering and lightbox functionality
Detailed 'About Me' section with artist statement
Customizable contact form with inquiry options
Blog/News section for project updates and insights

design.typography: Headings: Serif (e.g., Playfair Display); Body: Sans-serif (e.g., Open Sans)
design.layout: Grid-based, full-width hero sections, generous white/dark space, responsive and mobile-first.
